The mine is a short dungeon exploration segment with a few easy Clash battles. Walk around breaking boxes and opening treasure chests to obtain some loot. Do not examine the golden rock marked by the compass until you're completely finished looting the area and opening all the chests.
3
Examine the Golden Rock
When you're all done, examine the golden rock to kick off a cutscene that automatically commences the chapter battle, Battle vs. Balboa. Completing the battle will end the chapter.

Battle at Coris Mine Walkthrough

Chapter 3: The Rose of Caelus

1
Save Maria from Bandits
After some lengthy cutscenes, you'll automatically move to the world map and enter Event Clash (a scripted clash battle). Though Maria is present on the field, she is not playable, so just finish off the enemies with your usual roster.
2
Head to Kalla's Temple

After more cutscenes (and a brief encounter with the spooky Ghost Chariot), you'll automatically proceed to Kalla's Temple. You can explore and talk to NPCs.

Approaching the elevated throne will kick off a cutscene and throw you into the chapter battle against Leda's longtime rival, Olympia, to end the chapter.

The Rose of Caelus Walkthrough

Chapter 4: The Indelible Past

1
Attend the Heroic Games Opening Ceremony
After the cutscenes, you will unlock the Gate of the Gods teleportation, and enter Dagsion proper on 3/1.

Though Kalla gives you some money for shopping, most of your movement about the city will be restricted at this point, so it's best to follow the marker to enter Midtown and attend the opening of the Heroic Games. The subsequent cutscenes will award your team some weapon EXP.
2
Head to the Tavern in Lowtown

When you regain control, follow the marker to Lowtown to kick off another round of cutscenes.

Later, as a form of soft recruitment tutorial, Buccar will bring Catania to you, but she will initially refuse to join, because your Renown is too low.

This in turn kicks off a tutorial for Perform Quests, Leda's unique quest type. The process of clearing the quests Dance at the Tavern and Dance for Yaaman will unlock the Song of Icewater Blaze Art and get you some rewards and Renown.

Renown Guide: How to Get Renown

3
Free Time Until 4/4

After your first Perform Quests, you'll skip forward to 3/21 and receive 58 Turns of Free Time, with a 4/4 deadline to the chapter battle.
How to Pass Time

5
Recruit Catania at Renown Lv. 2

Renown is critical for unit recruitment, and you need Renown Level 2 in order to recruit Catania, a spear specialist and a handy 6th member for your squad.

After getting to Renown level 2, return to Dagsion to recruit Catania. She will start at Level 4, so you'll want her in the party ASAP so she can participate in dungeon fights and skirmishes to level up.

6
Perform in Daimon and Regia

Two local Perform Quests will unlock after you begin Free Time, and we recommend you do both. Making your way to the destinations (Daimon and Regia) will help open up the map, as well.
Performing in Daimon will reveal the Verdant Hollow Skirmish Stage. Clearing this node and Searching it will reward you with Sweet Leaves, which you need to clear another of Leda's unique quests, Simple Drink Recipes, once you hit Renown Lv. 3 next chapter.

Skirmish Guide

7
Power Up in Dungeons and Skirmishes

Take time to explore dungeons near Dagsion to level up your characters and obtain useful resources and loot. Additionally, random skirmish maps will also help build your characters' levels. Just be careful not to break your weapons from overuse in the field, as you may need their durability during the chapter battle later.

Dungeons and Clashes Guide

8
Watch Mikaela and Talimun's Optional Scenes

While exploring Dagsion, you'll have a chance to see optional scenes with Mikaela and Talimun, both located near the Dagsion shopping area. Mikaela's can be seen as soon as Free Time begins, while Talimun's kicks off the next time you return to Dagsion. Optional scenes further character development and help unlock Paralogues for relevant characters.

9
Prep for Chapter Battle on 4/4

Once you've explored or done all you can, the deadline will arrive on 4/4 and automatically teleport you to the chapter-closing Battle vs. Lechner.

The Indelible Past Walkthrough Guide

Chapter 5: Women at Battle

1
Learn Arena Training
It is time for Leda's team, Rose Tempest, to prepare of its first Qualifier match. That means learning how to do Arena Training, a new type of Weekly Activity to add to your rotation. Simply follow the instructions and pick a partner for Leda's first Infantry Training. We recommend either Sirocco or Mu, as both will benefit from the boost to Sword and Bow EXP. Arena Guide: How to Train Units
2
Reclass Your Party
Character Recommended Class
Buccar Gladiator or Ornius Rider
Mu Hunter or Gladiator
Olympia Diviner
(Hunter or Gladiator if Diviner is mastered)
Sirocco Diviner or Hunter
Catania Soldier or Ornius Rider
Guzran Gladiator
(Hunter if Gladiator is mastered)
Leda Hunter
You will also finally unlock the ability to reclass into Beginner classes for your party. Leda will automatically be reclassed to Hunter.

After you're freed to do your weeklies, buy Beginner Certifications from the License Vendor and reclass your members. Make sure to also swap out their equipment and accessories as needed before proceeding. List of Classes
3
Free Time Until 5/7
Your free time for this chapter is quite long: 120 Turns with a deadline of 5/7. As always, we recommend completing subquests and clearing dungeons to advance your character. Prioritize Leda's Perform Quests for big Renown boosts and unique opportunities. List of All Quests
4
Level Up and Grab Anti-Armor Options
You'll want to prepare to take on multiple Armored Knights in the chapter battle, so it's best to level up to average level 12.

Improving your magic users is key, so train Sirocco and Olympia to improve their spellcasting. If you claimed the free update weapons, giving Olympia or another gauntlet-user the Breidablik gun will greatly augment her battle effectiveness against armor.

You can also purchase an Anti-Armor Weapon like the Flyssa Sword from Callaineira Port or a Halberd from Ravio Port (both accessible near your Perform Quest locations), but such items are expensive and limited. How to Claim Free Update Bonuses
5
Explore Dungeons for Resources
Renown Levels 2 and 3 will open up more provincial gateways to pass through on the world map, including some dungeons with good loot and plenty of battle opportunities. Push south and southeast of Dagsion and find time to clear Rubess Forest, Nowah's Cave, and Shadowy Cave. You may even choose to push east, visiting Cai's hometown of Ribeira and thereabouts.

Chapter 5: Women at Battle

Chapter 6: The Soaring Maiden

1
Learn to use the Exchange
The chapter will open with a mandatory tutorial on how to use the Exchange, a special merchant that trades materials for rare gear. Follow the marker to the Dagsion Port for a short cutscene. We suggest acquiring a Horsekiller Bow if you happen to have an Enrietto handy. This bow is excellent against cavalry, and also against flying units, which you will face in the chapter battle. List of Bows
2
Free Time Until 5/28
You'll have less Free Time this chapter, just 76 Turns until your Qualifier match on Mae 28. Make sure to do your weekly activities and recruit new characters like Kiroc or Jasmine, before heading out of town.
3
Watch Scenes with Olympia and Alexandra

You'll be able to see optional scenes with both Olympia and Alexandra at the start of Free Time. For Olympia, just run down the hill from Temple Row towards the gate to Midtown.

Alexandra is in the City Streets area near the Item Shop. Speak to her, then head past the Lowtown Tavern for a second scene that sheds light on the upcoming battle.

3
Progress to Level 15

Your ideal party for the battle should have seven characters and several with ranged attacks, particularly bows. Consider classing some members to Hunter. Kiroc can be a strong archer if you need another one besides Leda and possibly Mu.

Level up by clearing dungeons and running skirmishes on the world map. We suggest clearing dungeons like Hundred-Hole Cave and Corroios Fort Ruins or running skirmishes in Aragon (accessed by going through Kalla's Temple Gate to teleport).

How to Recruit Kiroc

4
Boost Renown With Quests

Make sure to accomplish all available Subquests this chapter, particularly Perform Quests, as they will be your best source of Renown. Doing them will ensure that the chapter battle pushes you into Rank 5.

List of All Quests

The Soaring Maiden Walkthrough Guide

Chapter 7: Rose of Retribution

1
Free Time Until 6/28
Unlike previous chapters, you will immediately enter Free Time after the opening cutscenes. You have 120 turns to spend as you see fit.
2
Speak to Sirocco for a Unique Quest
Before heading off to tackle your weekly activities, speak to Sirocco near the gate to Midtown, to kick off a Leda-exclusive subquest called Learning More About Mahdel.

To clear it, you just need to speak to some marked NPCs near Upper Temple Row, then return to Sirocco for a cutscene.
3
Give Your Members Specialty Classes
Character Recommended Class
Leda Archer
Buccar Brigand or Armored Knight
Mu Rogue or Pugilist (depending on if you prefer bows or melee for her)
Olympia Priest or Shaman
Sirocco Shaman
Catania Light Cavalry or Armored Knight
Guzran Myrmidon
Io Light Cavalry
Jasmine Armored Knight
Kiroc Archer
Your primary goal for this chapter is to level up your main party to have a seven-person squad of at least level 20, especially your core group, and set up in a Specialty Class. These are our recommendations based on the available recruits and their specialization:

It's likely that only your core party will make it to Level 20 in time for the battle, so reserve your available certification licenses for them.
4
Acquire a Cleansing Sword
As mentioned in the battle foresight and Anna's suggestion in the Adventure Log, you'll face Undead enemies in significant numbers. To that end, pick up a Cleansing Sword from the exchange (you'll need 3x Ladon Pike) for one of your melee characters. You can also buy it from the city of Osiris in the far northwest (accessible via Kalla's Temple Gate on your way past Barsk Post Town for your quest).

The Cleansing Sword does extra damage to undead and bypasses their Underworld Boon effect.
5
Get Anti-Armor Weapons
One thing NOT mentioned by Anna, though, is the presence of both Armored Knights and Light Cavalry in the mix. You'll want an anti-armor melee weapon like the Flyssa sword or Halberd spear to help your melee units take down these pesky foes.

For the rest of the team Iron Weapons are a good tier to upgrade to generally.
6
Level up in Dungeons and Skirmishes
As ever, focus on completing your subquests and Perform Quests when you leave the city. These will give you needed funds to pay for gifts, training, and meals, and boost your Renown.

You should also explore the areas near the Perform Quest locations, which are higher level. We suggest dungeons like the Fort Hayn, Dione Fort, Valhalla Mine, and nearby skirmishes to build up your characters and loot materials in time for the chapter battle on 6/28.

Rose of Retribution Walkthrough Guide

Chapter 8: Shape of the Conspiracy

1
Free Time Until 7/9
After a very short interlude where you must bring Leda to the tavern between two lengthy cutscenes, you will unlock a new Blaze Art, Song of Beasts, and begin a very short Free Time until 7/9. At just 36 turns, this is your shortest Free Time period to date.
2
Focus on Subquests and Weeklies
You won't have much time this chapter to dawdle. There are no new Perform Quests in this chapter, so instead focus on completing the available subquests and running skirmishes and dungeons you see on the way between them to level up. Try to make it back to Dagsion in time to hit your Weekly Activities - you'll get at least two weeks' worth from this period.
3
Use Carriages to Fast Travel
To give you the most time possible to explore, consider paying for Carriages at the Post Stations outside Dagsion. Travel by carriage does not spend time and can teleport you close to a quest destination, leaving you extra turns to visit nodes or run dungeons.
4
Target Level 22 and Specialty Classes
The chapter battle features many archers, so units with long movement range like Light Cavalry and Armored Ornius Riders are good to have. Avoid Wing Soldiers, as despite their mobility, they will be easy prey for the archers on the field.

However, at least one tanky Armored Knight and one or two characters with healing magic will be much-needed. If your white magic-wielders can learn the long-range heal spell Physic, that will also make things more convenient during the fight.

Shape of the Conspiracy Walkthrough Guide

Chapter 9: Discordance

1
Free Time Until 9/1
After the opening cutscenes, you'll enter Free Time until Seftim 1, giving you an unprecedented 204 turns until your match.
2
Get a Subquest to Unlock Dancer
As the chapter begins, you'll be contacted by an NPC for a subquest that unlocks Leda's exclusive Advanced Class: the Dancer.

The material required for the quest, Hingosh, can only be found by going to Baina Oasis in the middle of the western desert.

You should have enough time to finish the quest this chapter, but you can also do so next chapter before the 10/15 deadline if you don't feel like exploring the desert. List of All Advanced Classes
3
Target Level 30+ for Advanced Classes
You'll have a lot of time and a lot of traveling to do this chapter, and you should spend it getting as many of your core members up to Level 30 and beyond this chapter.

Though that is a bit overkill to simply pass the chapter battle, this is preparation for unlocking Advanced Classes as early as possible in Chapter 10. The certification exam for Advanced Classes requires level 35 and above and Renown Rank 8, and getting your favorites on the road to that level threshold is key.
4
Travel Far and Wide for Quests
You have many quests to tackle this time, with their destinations placed around Dagda's coastline. Move efficiently and try to take advantage of Carriages to instantly teleport nearer to quest locations.

During this time, don't ignore your Weekly Activities, either. Arena Training and weapon skills are needed to unlock many advanced classes. Best Classes for Each Character

Discordance Walkthrough Guide

Chapter 10: A Father's Request and a Daughter's Wish

1
Free Time Until 10/15
After the opening cutscenes, you'll have a short Free Time period before the semifinals. Your 10/15 deadline gives you just 68 Turns to do what you need to do.
2
Take On Paralogues
This chapter introduces Paralogues a special character-focused mission type. Paralogues have very strict activation windows, and are missable, so always try to do them as soon as you can.

Ideally, you can plan your movement around the map pursuing subquests to take up paralogues as you pass by for best efficiency. In this chapter, only Anatolia's Paralogue is available, and must be started between 10/12 and 10/17. List of All Paralogues
3
Grab Advanced Classes
During this chapter, the License Vendor will start selling Advanced Licenses, allowing you (assuming you're at or near Renown Rank 8) to promote any character over level 35 that meets requirements to an Advanced Class.

We recommend unlocking Dancer for Leda by accomplishing her quest (the deadline falls within this chapter, too), then promoting your frontline fighters into an advanced class, particularly melee fighters and mounted units. These will come in handy during the chapter battle on 10/15.

A Father's Request and a Daughter's Wish Walkthrough Guide

Chapter 11: Banquet of the Risen Dead

1
Free Time Until 11/6
The penultimate Free Time period of Part 1 is relatively short, giving you 85 Turns before your Nuvim 6 deadline.
2
Exclusive Quests Unlock New Classes
If you've been completing Leda's Perform Quests and related subquests like Drink Recipes from the Dagsion Tavern Owner, you should have Dance for Benetnasch and Elegant Drink Recipes remaining. Try to complete both of these to unlock the Ranger and Troubador advanced classes for Leda's path.

Ranger is an upgrade to the Rogue Specialty class and is good for Leda if she's already mastered - or hasn't unlocked - her exclusive Dancer class. Troubador is a mounted caster class that may add some much-needed mobility to Olympia or Sirocco (if you built him as a caster), so long as they have some Riding skill accumulated. Performance Guide
3
Prioritize Paralogues

As much as possible, try to prioritize completing Paralogues in the time you have available. If you've already completed Anatolia's Paralogue, three more will show up by 10/18: Dietrich's, Cai's and Orchel's.

Cai's and Orchel's Paralogues have tight timing requirements, so speak to them on 10/16 and 10/18, respectively, to unlock them as soon as you can. Paralogues have excellent rewards, so don't worry about missing out on money or EXP farming by focusing on them over exploring the map this chapter.

List of All Paralogues

4
Prepare for Yet More Undead

Almost the whole chapter battle will be full of Undead enemies of various classes, so it's best to stock up on anti-undead weapons like Cleansing Blades and the Seraphim spell.

Try to have a Cleansing Blade for each of your strong melee fighters available. The length of the battle and other factors may prevent you from leaning on Leda's Song of Abjuring Blaze Art to bypass their Underworld Boon. Anti-armor weapons like Hammer, Halberd, and Flyssa, along with magical attacks, will be useful for dealing with undead armored units.

Additionally, it's a good idea to upgrade to Da Mina-tier weapons, and spend some of your ores at the Blacksmith to refine your special anti-type weapons to increase their damage output. Repairing weapons with favored Combat Arts is good, so you don't break any in this long fight.

How to Get Cleansing Blade and Stats

5
Seek Divine Blessings

Aurora's Blessings will reduce damage taken by the party, and the level 3 blessing will temporarily remove Underworld Boon from a target. Using these blessings can keep your party in good shape during the chapter battle, so consider focusing your weekly temple service on seeking Aurora's favor.

Alternatively, Jurah's Level 3 Blessing also temporarily removes Underworld Boon, but her Level 1 and 2 blessings aren't as broadly useful for this stage as Aurora's.

Temple Guide: How to Get Blessings

6
Avoid Cursed Weapons

You may have some powerful cursed weapons you like, such as Lakshasha's Fan, Veroquine, or Azago's Bow. We would avoid using these on Leda during this chapter's battle, as you will want to use Blaze Arts often in this stage. Excessive Blaze buildup can lead Leda to enter burst, which lowers her max HP and puts her at risk.

List of Blaze Arts

Banquet of the Risen Dead Walkthrough Guide

Chapter 12: Revenge's End

1
Free Time Until 11/27
This is it! The last Free Time run of Part 1 gives you 80 turns until the Nuvim 27 deadline.
2
Level Up and Get Advanced Classes
If you've kept up with subquest completions, there shouldn't be too much left to do in terms of map exploration for this part. There are also no new Perform Quests, so you can just worry about clearing any ones you've left undone.

Otherwise, focus your efforts on improving your main squad of 10 units, bringing them up to level 40 or higher and reclassing them to Advanced Classes (you should really be at Rank 8-10 Renown by now).

You may need to buy additional Advanced Class Licenses. These can be purchased from Dagsion's License Vendor, but also provincial capitals like Megaira. Consider looking for them while out on the world map looking for dungeons or skirmishes to level up with. How to Level Up Fast
3
Buy Useful Weapons and Gear
Use the world map to view Wares for different locations to find weapons or gear you might want to pick up for your party. Weapons with anti-armor or anti-cavalry attributes will be useful, as well as defensive gear like shields or gems. In general, you want your party to be fully equipped with Da Mina weapons or better.

Consumables will also help tip the balance, such as popping a Special Drink for a battle-length boost or having an armored unit take some Pure Water to defend against an imminent magical attack. List of All Weapons and Spells
4
Refine Favored Weapons
Don't forget to stop by the Blacksmith to refine your favorite weapons, if you haven't yet. An additional refinement for a lower-tier specialty weapon can give it the edge over a higher-tier generic one, particularly in certain class matchups.

Don't forget to repair your used weapons as well. There's nothing more annoying than running out of uses for a weapon with a favorite Combat Art (like the Longbow with Deadeye) How to Refine Weapons
5
Don't Neglect Training
While you're out looking for fights, don't forget to return to Dagsion periodically to complete Weekly Training. Maximizing your units' weapon skills can get them closer to their favored classes, and unlock new spells and Combat Arts to use in the coming battles.

In particular, you should train White Magic users that can access Physic, like Olympia or Sofia. Physic allows characters to heal from a distance. Arena Guide: How to Train Units

Revenge's End Walkthrough Guide

Part 2: War Arc

Jump to a Section
Prologue
Cai Dietrich
Theodora Leda
Part 2 Part 3
All Part 2: War Chapters
1 2 3 4 5 6

Chapter 1: The Battle of Klytius Plains

1
Go Over Available Part 2 Facilities

Unlike Part 1, Part 2 is a lot more simplified, with minimal things to do in between battles. While you still have some of the usual facilities, like Inn and Exam Proctor, their mechanics are a lot more limited or streamlined to help speed things up during the War Arc.

2
Boost Your Units with Army Actions

The only new facility during Part 2 is the Dispatch Officer. Aside from starting the main battle, this is where you can boost your underpowered units to match the strength of your stronger characters.

If you have under-levelled units that you want to use, it's recommended to pick Training Drills. However, if you already have 10 units that are good to go, you can opt to do Group Drills to increase Weapon Skill Levels instead.

3
Promote Units to Advanced Classes

One unique thing about Part 2 is that the Exam Proctor will have 5 Advanced Licenses ready to use every chapter. Since these are free and reset after every battle, it's recommended to use them up before going into battle, unless you want to max out a Specialty Class first.

List of All Advanced Classes

4
Prepare Counters to Cavalry Units

While there are a bunch of different enemy types coming up in the next battle, the three named enemies you want to look out for are all riding horses. Before you go into the fight, make sure you've prepared anti-cavalry units and weapons to quickly take them down.

The Battle of Klytius Plains Walkthrough

Chapter 2: Showdown at Agris Stronghold

1
Have 13 Units Ready
The upcoming battle is by far the largest fight you'll have since you'll have to deal with controlling 13 different units in your army, not including guest characters. Make sure to use the streamlined free time system to prepare enough characters for the upcoming battle.
2
Prepare High Mobility Classes
Similar to the last map, the next battle will take place in a large area with multiple enemies dotted around the place. Because of this, you'll want to have classes that can quickly get in and out of combat.


Ideally, you'll want flying units since there's a large cliff in the center of the map, but cavalry is also fine if you're worried about enemy archers shooting them down or you're lacking fliers. List of Classes
3
Use Cavalry Counters and Mages
Aside from fast units, other key characters you'll want to prepare are anti-cavalry and mages. This is because, like last time, there are a bunch of powerful mounted enemies, as well as high-defence knights that you'll have to defeat.

Showdown at Agris Stronghold Walkthrough

Chapter 3: Beyond the Salt Road

1
Prepare Extra Healers
Much like the first two chapters, there isn't much to do besides preparing for the upcoming battle. For this one, it's recommended to bring extra healers since the arena has narrow corridors, which can get hectic towards the end of the battle. List of All Classes
2
Train Extra Fliers if You Haven't Yet
If you haven't done so in the previous chapter, you should look to train more flying units if possible. They can easily circumvent the narrow corridors of the battle map, but you'll have to watch out for the myriad of chariot archers during the fight.
3
Increase Blessing Levels
As mentioned earlier, the later stages of the fight can get pretty crazy, and using Blessings can help make the fight a lot more manageable. Generally, Kalla's Blessing is extremely useful for the dodge chance and extra movement speed, so try to level her's up to 3 if you haven't done so yet.


Also, as an extra point, this should be the time when you should start getting used to using Blessings in key fights, if you haven't been doing so already. Things will only get harder from here, so you should get used to using them to help make fights easier. Temple Guide: How to Get Blessings
4
Train and Bring Creek
If you have Creek recruited, you should train and bring him to the next battle. This is because he needs to defeat Nathan during the fight to recruit him in the next chapter , which is something you don't want to miss out on.

How to Recruit Creek

Beyond the Salt Road Walkthrough

Chapter 4: The Storming of Dagsion

1
Train Anti-Cavalry and Anti-Flying
The main threats of the enemy army in this chapter are fliers, as well as elephant and ornius riders. This means you will want to train up units that can counter both flying and mounted enemies to make it easy to survive the incoming onslaught.


It's generally recommended to use a strong defensive frontline to counter the mounted units, while you have backline archers and wind mages to deal with the fliers. List of All Classes
2
Make Any Final Preparations
As a note, this is the final chapter where you can make use of the free time facilities. Once you move on to Chapter 5, you can only use the Pale Raven's Perch, and you won't be able to make your army stronger outside of battle.

The Storming of Dagsion Walkthrough

Chapter 5: Divine Emperor Dagda

1
Explore Dagsion
Now that you're back in Dagsion, you can take some time to see what's happened to the place since you were gone. However, there isn't much to do, and you're restricted to certain locations, so you can immediately progress to the next battle after checking the Battle Foresight from the Perch.
2
Fix Up Your Army
Before proceeding to the main battle, take some time to go over your army and sort out their inventories, skills, and combat arts. The remaining battles in Part 2 will have you using 13 units the entire time, so you'll want to prepare your best characters and make them as strong as possible.
3
Go to Dagsion Summit
When you're ready, head to the top of Dagsion and approach the temple at the summit. This will start the main battle, where you'll face Dagda and his troops.

Divine Emperor Dagda Walkthrough

Chapter 6: The Underworld Incarnate

1
Prepare for Back-to-Back Battles

Since this is the last chapter in Part 2, the enemies will go all out, and you'll end this section with back-to-back battle scenarios. The first fight will have you facing a boss with 2 phases, while the second fight has you escaping a horde of underworld soldiers.

Thankfully, there is a prep phase in between the fights, so you can swap around items and characters to better deal with the two different battle scenarios.

The Underworld Incarnate Walkthrough

Part 3: Salvation Arc

Jump to a Section
Prologue
Cai Dietrich
Theodora Leda
Part 2 Part 3
All Part 3: Salvation Chapters
1 2 3 4 5 6

First Section: The Liberation of Dagsion

1
Go Through the Dungeon Section
The First Section of Chapter 3 is essentially a prologue for the time-skip section of the game, so there's nothing much to do for now. The only thing you can do before the main battle is to go through a short dungeon section where you face off against a few enemies to get some extra experience.
2
Heal at the Rest Spot
Before you leave the dungeon section, make sure to use the Rest Spot near the lift that goes down to the port. However, if you aren't injured at all, then there's no need to use this, and you can continue to the Battle vs. Dagda.

The Liberation of Dagsion Walkthrough

Second Section: True Strength

1
Optional: Do Farming Runs in Part 1
One of the major tasks in Part 3 is visiting locations and repairing them using materials gathered around the world. Since there's not a lot of spare time in Part 3, you can opt to go back to Cai's or Theodora's Path in Part 1 and farm materials to bring over to Part 3.

This does take a while to do since you will also need to redo Part 2 with the new Part 1 saves. However, it's well worth it if you don't want to be strapped for time in Part 3, and especially if you don't have a lot of materials to begin with. List of All Items
2
Re-Recruit Everyone
The first major thing you should do once you reach the Second Section is re-recruit every ally from Part 1. If you've recruited the same character on multiple paths, you'll be able to choose which one will carry over to Part 3.

As a note, you can use the Merge Causality feature at the Shrine of Causality to merge the different versions of a character. This costs Karma Shards, and doing this will buff the Part 3 character's stats. All Characters and Playable Units
3
Accept New Quests
While you're running around recruiting characters, you can also accept any new quests you come across. They all have a deadline of 6/6, which is the end of Part 3, so you can choose to do these at any time.

If ever, it's recommended to do the god quests found at their respective temples first, as well as the new Leda Perform Quest. The rewards from these quests are very useful and will serve you well in the battles ahead. List of All Quests
4
Plan Out Squads
Another big feature of Part 3 is the ability to create squads and move multiple parties around the map. You start with two squads, and eventually go up to five, so make sure to plan out your teams ahead of time so you don't have to keep disbanding and remaking squads.

At the start, it's recommended to have Theodora and Cai in separate squads so they can farm any materials you need. Aside from that, you'll want characters that can counter the Underworld Boon, like White Mages and Cleansing Blade users, as well as characters like Orchel, Anatolia, and Leda.
5
Plan Out Repairs
As mentioned in the optional step, a lot of Part 3 will have you running around the world and repairing locations and facilities. Depending on the state of your current save, the recommended repair priorities can change, so take some time to view the world map and see what you want to fix first.

Generally, you'll want to repair the Posthouses and Temples first for fast travel and quest access, respectively, but the priorities for Settlements and Dagsion's Facilities change depending on what you need the most.

Also, as a note, you can buy the Building Materials for the Dagsion Facilities at repaired settlements across the map.
6
Upgrade to Master Classes
Now that you're in Part 3, you'll unlock the new tier of Master Classes that are more powerful than the Advanced ones from Part 1. Make sure to buy up as many Master Licenses as possible so you can start upgrading your army to the next tier of classes.

However, you won't be able to access some classes at the start, since you'll still need to unlock them by finishing the gods' quests first. As mentioned before, it's highly recommended to repair temples do these so you can gain access to the locked classes as soon as possible. List of All Master Classes
7
Upgrade Equipment
Besides classes, you'll also want to make sure to upgrade your army's equipment as well. You will now have access to Silver Weapons, as well as even higher-level upgrades at the Blacksmith. Part 3 is a lot harder than the previous two parts, so you'll want to make sure that you're fully prepared before heading out. List of All Weapons and Spells
8
Pass Time Until Deadline
With everything above in mind, you can now pass time until you reach the main quest deadline. Since you won't be able to do everything in the Second Section, it's recommended to start with unlocking important locations and facilities, as well as doing any quests you may have.

As mentioned before, one of the more important things to unlock in the Second Section is the Posthouses, so you can get around quicker in future chapters, and the Temples, so you can accept the god quests that reward you with Master Classes, as well as the Gate of the Gods teleporters and Trials with Supreme Arc Equipment rewards.
9
Search for Keys of the Diadem
One thing to take note of while passing time is to do dungeons and look for Keys of the Diadem within chests. These are later used in the Fourth Section to open doors in the Temple of the Diadem, which contain items that grant limited but extremely powerful Divine Classes.

However, most of the dungeons that have keys are found in the corners of the world, so it's often better to save the search for the later sections. However, if you're going near these locations anyways, you might as well take a few turns to stop by and pick them up. All Key of The Diadem Locations

True Strength Walkthrough

Third Section: The Inheritors

1
Create a Third Squad
Now that you're in the Third Section, you'll have an extra squad available to send out. A basic setup you could use is to have one squad going west, one east, and then one south. Just make sure they're all doing important tasks like Key of the Diadem hunting, completing quests, farming materials, and visiting locations.

If you want to reorganize your teams, you will need to disband a squad first so that you can reassign the individual units. This doesn't take a turn if you do it right away while everyone's in Dagsion, so make sure to fix up your squads before heading out.
2
Recruit Centurio
If you've finished Rescue Centurio and haven't done this in the last section, you should go and recruit him now while you're in Dagsion. There's a chance you haven't returned after beating the giants and saving him, so you might not have had the opportunity to pick him up yet. How to Recruit Centurio
3
Get All 5 Keys of the Diadem
Since the Temple of the Diadem is unlocked in the next section, it's highly recommended to get all five keys now. If you don't have the time for it, you can leave one key for the next chapter, and have someone pick it up while another squad is on their way to the temple. All Key of The Diadem Locations
4
Repair Dagsion's Facilities
By now, you should have some Building Materials to repair the facilities in Dagsion. Make sure to do this so you can regain access to the standard weekly activities once more.

Do note, however, that only units in Dagsion can make use of the facilities. If Theodora, for example, is out in the overworld, she won't be able to use the arena or eat food at an inn. All Weekly Activities
5
Finish God Quests and Do Trials
If you didn't have time to do these in the previous section, you should make sure that you repair every temple and do each gods' quest now. Aside from the rewards, Master Class unlocks, and teleporter access, you'll also be able to take on a Trial that will reward you with powerful equipment for your army.

The Inheritors Walkthrough

Fourth Section: The Hopes of Monarchs and the People

1
Finish Up Any To-Dos
Being in the fourth section means that you now have four squads to use, making getting around the world and finishing tasks a lot easier. As much as possible, try to finish all of your quests and repairs in this chapter so that you can focus on training your units in the fifth section.
2
Unlock Divine Classes
The only new thing that you'll need to do is go to the Temple of the Diadem and unlock the Divine Classes. If you haven't obtained all the keys during the third section, you'll want to send a squad to do this as soon as possible.

Make sure to also bring your squads back to Dagsion so that you can reclass your strongest units to the best classes in the game. Try to do this as soon as you can so that you can start levelling up the class. List of Divine Classes
3
Start Finalizing Builds
Since we're rapidly closing in on the end of the game, you'll want to start thinking about your final character and squad builds. You should have enough Master Licenses and Divine Classes to build out your four squads, as well as your future fifth and final team. Best Classes for Each Character
4
Clear Out Dungeons for EXP
Once you've got nothing else to do, it's recommended to just go around the world and clear every dungeon you come across. Aside from the random battles on the world map, this is the best way to level up your teams in preparation for the Underworld Gates. How to Level Up Fast

The Hopes of Monarchs and the People Walkthrough

Fifth Section: Song of the Living

1
Level Up Main Squads
Once you're done with every Quest, location repair, and anything else available, the only thing left to do is grind EXP and make your main squads as strong as possible. Like in the Fourth Section, you'll want to do dungeons to maximize your experience gains, then battle any enemy you can find afterward.

For reference, the final battle will have you using 25 units across 3 squads, so make sure you distribute the EXP among those squads and have the other 2 squads level up through other methods.
2
Double Check Builds
This section of the story will have you taking on three Underworld Gates, and you'll be utilizing all five of your squads. Make sure to double-check your builds before heading into the gate phase so that none of your squads are underpowered.
3
Pass Time Until the Deadline
If there's nothing else left to do with your units and squad builds, you can go ahead and pass time until you reach the deadline. Just make sure you're all set before doing so, as there will be plenty of battles ahead.

Song of the Living Walkthrough

Sixth Section: To the Edge of Twilight

1
Train Up Final Army
Unless you still have some leftover tasks, there's nothing else to do besides train up your army for the final battle. You have plenty of time to run around and re-clear every dungeon on the map, so make sure your squads are fully levelled before heading to the Temple of Balor.
2
Fully Explore the Map

Just in case, you can spend extra free turns going around and double-checking every inch of the map for unexplored locations. You'll want to make sure you don't miss anything and potentially miss out on extra Karma Shards from Notable Deeds.

Notable Deeds: List of Milestones and Rewards

To the Edge of Twilight Walkthrough
